AISignal.title: AISignal
AISignal.description: One AI decision surfaced to the operator for confirmation.

AuditLog.title: AuditLog
AuditLog.description:
Append-only record of every config-changing action — who, when, what.

Surfaced read-only on the History page (Phase 6). Write endpoints record
entries here via `auth.audit.record_audit`.

Candle.title: Candle
Candle.description: A single OHLCV bar for one symbol/interval/market.

CompareRequest.title: CompareRequest
CompareRequest.description: A grid request — either pivot is just a different shape of the same.

CostBucket.title: CostBucket
CostBucket.description: One aggregation bucket — by model, purpose or day.

CostsRead.title: CostsRead
CostsRead.description: Trading-cost breakdown, the fee-rate reference, and today's LLM spend.

CostsSummary.title: CostsSummary
CostsSummary.description: Headline spend + the breakdowns the Costs screen renders.

CouncilReviewRead.title: CouncilReviewRead
CouncilReviewRead.description: A council verdict plus every member's vote.

CouncilSettingsUpdate.title: CouncilSettingsUpdate
CouncilSettingsUpdate.description: Council configuration — an empty member list disables the council.

Decision.title: Decision
Decision.description: A structured trading decision parsed from an LLM response.

EquitySnapshot.title: EquitySnapshot
EquitySnapshot.description: A point-in-time snapshot of portfolio equity — powers the equity curve.

GraphEdge.title: GraphEdge
GraphEdge.description: A directed, labelled relation from one node to another.

GraphNode.title: GraphNode
GraphNode.description: A node: an asset, a product, or a concept.

GraphView.title: GraphView
GraphView.description: The connections graph — nodes and the edges between them.

InstanceCreate.title: InstanceCreate
InstanceCreate.description: Apply a strategy type to a coin as a new named instance.

LLMUsage.title: LLMUsage
LLMUsage.description: One recorded LLM completion — tokens, estimated cost, and the decision.

LatencyRead.title: LatencyRead
LatencyRead.description: Price-feed latency — per-feed stats plus the overall degraded flag.

LatencyStatsRead.title: LatencyStatsRead
LatencyStatsRead.description: Rolling-window latency for one (market, symbol, kind).

LlmCredentialsUpdate.title: LlmCredentialsUpdate
LlmCredentialsUpdate.description: One LLM provider's credentials — both fields optional.

MarketAnalysis.title: MarketAnalysis
MarketAnalysis.description: One AI pass over a market — estimated probability vs market price.

ModelUsage.title: ModelUsage
ModelUsage.description: Per-model rollup of LLM activity — 'what each model did'.

NewsItem.title: NewsItem
NewsItem.description: A single news headline pulled from an RSS feed.

PolymarketSettingsUpdate.title: PolymarketSettingsUpdate
PolymarketSettingsUpdate.description: Polymarket configuration — discovery/screening cadence and bars.

Position.title: Position
Position.description:
One strategy's position in one symbol/market — the attribution row.

`qty` is always >= 0; `side` gives the direction. `realized_pnl` and
`fees_paid` accumulate over the position's lifetime (the row is kept after
a position goes flat so cumulative PnL is preserved).

PredictionMarket.title: PredictionMarket
PredictionMarket.description: One Polymarket market, upserted from the Gamma API by `condition_id`.

RecommendResponse.title: RecommendResponse
RecommendResponse.description: The AI's pick, backtested so it ranks alongside the grid cells.

ResearchReportRead.title: ResearchReportRead
ResearchReportRead.description: One report — `sections` is the parsed schema-formatted content.

ResearchRun.title: ResearchRun
ResearchRun.description: Manual trigger — one symbol, or blank for every watched symbol.

ResearchSettingsUpdate.title: ResearchSettingsUpdate
ResearchSettingsUpdate.description: Research configuration — watched symbols, interval and writer LLM.

RiskSettingsUpdate.title: RiskSettingsUpdate
RiskSettingsUpdate.description:
Global risk limits in percent (SL/TP/drawdown) or quote currency
(loss limit, notional). 0 disables a limit.

Role.title: Role
Role.description:
Operator role. `admin` has full access; `user` is restricted
(see plan: Authentication & Roles).

StrategyRead.title: StrategyRead
StrategyRead.description: A strategy's identity, lifecycle state and accounting summary.

StrategyTypeRead.title: StrategyTypeRead
StrategyTypeRead.description: One pickable strategy type and its parameter schema.

Trade.title: Trade
Trade.description:
An executed fill — the transaction-log row, attributed to a strategy.

`realized_pnl` is the PnL booked *by this fill* (0 for opening/adding fills,
non-zero when it reduces or closes a position).

TradingMode.title: TradingMode
TradingMode.description: Where orders are routed. Sim is the safe default.

VenueCredentialsUpdate.title: VenueCredentialsUpdate
VenueCredentialsUpdate.description: A venue's credential fields — names validated against the catalogue.

WatchdogStatus.description: Engine liveness assessed from the heartbeat and open-position count.
